# pve_metric_server (Resource)

External metric server (graphite, influxdb, or opentelemetry).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_metric_server" "example" {
  item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
  port    = 1
  server  = "CHANGE_ME"
  type    = "graphite"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The ID of the entry.
- `port` (Number) server network port
- `server` (String) server dns name or IP address
- `type` (String) Plugin type. One of: `graphite`, `influxdb`, `opentelemetry`.

### Optional

- `api_path_prefix` (String) An API path prefix inserted between '<host>:<port>/' and '/api2/'. Can be useful if the InfluxDB service runs behind a reverse proxy.
- `bucket` (String) The InfluxDB bucket/db. Only necessary when using the http v2 api.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `disable` (Boolean) Flag to disable the plugin.
- `influxdbproto` (String) (default: udp) One of: `udp`, `http`, `https`.
- `max_body_size` (Number) InfluxDB max-body-size in bytes. Requests are batched up to this size. (default: 25000000)
- `mtu` (Number) MTU for metrics transmission over UDP (default: 1500)
- `organization` (String) The InfluxDB organization. Only necessary when using the http v2 api. Has no meaning when using v2 compatibility api.
- `otel_compression` (String) Compression algorithm for requests (default: gzip) One of: `none`, `gzip`.
- `otel_headers` (String) Custom HTTP headers (JSON format, base64 encoded)
- `otel_max_body_size` (Number) Maximum request body size in bytes (default: 10000000)
- `otel_path` (String) OTLP endpoint path (default: /v1/metrics)
- `otel_protocol` (String) HTTP protocol (default: https) One of: `http`, `https`.
- `otel_resource_attributes` (String) Additional resource attributes as JSON, base64 encoded
- `otel_timeout` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds (default: 5)
- `otel_verify_ssl` (Boolean) Verify SSL certificates (default: 1)
- `path` (String) root graphite path (ex: proxmox.mycluster.mykey)
- `proto` (String) Protocol to send graphite data. TCP or UDP (default) One of: `udp`, `tcp`.
- `timeout` (Number) graphite TCP socket timeout (default=1) (default: 1)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The InfluxDB access token. Only necessary when using the http v2 api. If the v2 compatibility api is used, use 'user:password' instead.
- `verify_certificate` (Boolean) Set to 0 to disable certificate verification for https endpoints. (default: 1)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
